issues: The HS Program of Studies doc itself contains department overviews and course tables (title, length, credits) but NOT per-course descriptions: each course title hyperlinks to a separate Google Doc/Drive 'Course Syllabus' (~150 linked files, e.g. 'Course Name: Integrated Math 1A, Year: 2026-2027'). Those are public (sampled 3, all exportable) but were not downloaded; Phase 2 will need to follow the links in the PDF (/URI annotations are preserved) or rely on titles+credits. Some linked syllabi are older (one art syllabus says 'Fall 2025'). Many courses are marked '^^' with no legend in the doc (meaning unknown; possibly not offered every year). HS doc also lists middle-school courses. Graduation requirements table is in the POS (26 credits; note typo 'Social Studies: Three and a half (3) credits' + Civics 0.5). The Google Doc is edited in place — the Counseling site caption still says 25-26 and a web-search summary of the MS doc also called it 2025-26, so the year can change under the same URL; recheck retrieval date.
